cohort: 322 children with rhabdomyosarcoma and 322 pair-matched controls
finding: Abnormal vaginal bleeding during pregnancy was the only maternal/birth characteristic statistically significantly associated with childhood rhabdomyosarcoma.
mod_finding: The study found no statistically significant association between mode of delivery and childhood rhabdomyosarcoma, though there was a positive but not statistically significant association between preterm birth and childhood rhabdomyosarcoma.
birth_weight: Low birth weight and high birth weight were strongly associated with alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma.
